query: Our app has a daily operations table that operators scan and act on repeatedly. It shows account, payment status, due time, amount, owner, and four valid dispositions. The table feels visually flat. Audit it and recommend task-fit improvements without replacing it with cards or disrupting established workflows.
expected_behavior: Names the operator task and preserves fields needed to compare cases and choose among valid dispositions
Recommends visual hierarchy and craft details that improve scanning without treating layout disruption as a goal
Keeps legitimate actions findable and weights them by task frequency and consequence rather than forcing one action to dominate
Suggests a way to assess the recommendation using a task outcome such as missed status, wrong disposition, or completion time
Stays at the specification level and does not invent product facts
